title: Is it possible to use the default RPG Maker MV tileset if you already own RPG Maker MV on the console?

posts.author: Ezclados
posts.body:
Hello, just like the question in the title.
Is it allowed to use the default tileset of RPG Maker MV if you already have RPG Maker MV on a console like PS4 or PS5?
I want to use some default RPG Maker MV tilesets or tilesets from some people that require me to have RPG Maker MV to use the tilesets.

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body: No, that's an entirely different License agreement
